NEGATIVE FINDINGS — morning UK research, 2 October 2026 (checked ~08:00-08:20 BST)

1. DRUMCREE COURT OF APPEAL HEARING — the hearing reported as listed for Friday 2 October DID NOT
   take place. Both BBC News NI (c62l8588y5v9o) and the Guardian/PA (2 Oct 02:07 BST) state the
   residents' fresh legal bid "had been due to be heard on Friday but was postponed until Monday".
   No time or courtroom is given in either approved source. DO NOT state a Friday hearing.

2. CARE-WORKER / EARNED SETTLEMENT DECISION — still not landed as at 08:20 BST, 2 Oct.
   No approved-source report of a Mahmood decision. Latest approved sourcing remains her Labour
   conference remarks of 28 Sep (BBC cmz7zxdy4gllo; Guardian 28 Sep) that she would "come to a
   position that balances fairness". Home Office line remains that no final decision is taken.

3. IEA GOVERNING BOARD OUTCOME — no approved source reports an outcome of an IEA governing board
   meeting. The BBC's 2 Oct diesel article does not mention the IEA at all; it reports only the
   UK energy minister's call with European counterparts on Thursday and European Commission
   "lots of calls, lots of meetings". No IEA decision can be stated.

4. FAIRFORD CHARGING DECISION — no charge, no further bail or release reported. No Home Office
   statement found in any approved outlet overnight. BBC's 2 Oct 01:20 BST update instead
   CORRECTS earlier detail (see point 5).

5. SNAP MAY 2027 ELECTION — reported only by the i Paper, which is NOT an approved outlet.
   It reaches us only through the BBC's press review. Flagged, not usable as a sourced claim.

6. BADENOCH CONFERENCE PRE-BRIEFING — the two fullest interviews are in the Daily Express and
   the Spectator (both banned) and ConservativeHome (not approved). PA copy ran on
   expressandstar.com (not approved). The Times has "Badenoch fired up for battle of the eighties
   v the seventies" but the body is paywalled. Approved-source material on the Tory conference is
   limited to BBC "Conservatives pledge 'tough love' benefit rules for under-25s" (1 Oct 14:20 BST,
   cklyjy9pv93yo). Conference dates confirmed by conservatives.com: Birmingham, Sun 4 - Wed 7 Oct.

7. GRANGEMOUTH SYNGENTA / ROSEBANK / LIB DEM TRIPLE LOCK / BBC LICENCE FEE — no overnight
   development found in any approved outlet; all remain at their 1 October state.
